title: Decode %27-style codes first
explain: Links write symbols as codes: %27 is ', %3C is <. Hackers hide their attacks this way. This turns the codes back into symbols before checking.

title: Ignore upper and lower case
explain: Hackers write UnIoN SeLeCt so a rule looking for 'union select' misses it. This makes everything small letters first.

title: Remove SQL comments /**/
explain: Databases ignore /**/ like a space, so UNION/**/SELECT still works. This deletes the comments first.

title: Squash extra spaces
explain: Turns many spaces or tabs into one space, so 'union    select' looks like 'union select'.

title: Decode <-style codes
explain: Web pages write < as <. If the shop decodes them later, an attack can hide inside. This decodes them first.

title: Remove hidden tab characters
explain: Browsers ignore a tab inside 'jav ascript:', filters do not. This deletes tabs so the word is whole again.

title: Block every apostrophe '
explain: Almost every SQL attack starts with '. But so do names like O'Brien and words like I'd.

title: Block ' OR ...=... (always true)
explain: Catches ' OR 1=1 and " OR ""=", which make a login check always true.

title: Block OR followed by a comparison
explain: Catches always-true tricks without quotes or without =, like 1 OR 2>1.

title: Block UNION SELECT
explain: UNION SELECT glues another table, such as users and passwords, onto the shop's answer.

title: Block the word SELECT
explain: SELECT is in most SQL attacks. It is also a normal English word.

title: Block a quote followed by -- or #
explain: -- and # start a comment in SQL. After a quote they cut off the rest of the query, such as the password check.

title: Block a second command after ;
explain: A ; ends one SQL command. A hacker adds a second one, like DROP TABLE, to delete data.

title: Block 'make the database wait'
explain: Blind attacks ask the database to wait 5 seconds. If the page is slow, the attack worked.

title: Block || (glue text together)
explain: || joins text in SQL, so a hacker can glue a stolen password into the shop's answer.

title: Block SQL error tricks
explain: extractvalue and updatexml can force the database to print secret data inside an error message.

title: Block <script>
explain: The classic way to run JavaScript inside someone else's page.

title: Block every < sign
explain: Every HTML tag starts with <. So does a heart <3 or maths like 2 < 4.

title: Block onerror=, onload= and friends
explain: HTML events run JavaScript when something happens, like an image failing to load.

title: Block javascript: links
explain: A link or iframe pointing to javascript: runs code instead of opening a page.

title: Block svg, iframe, details and body tags
explain: Rare tags that can run code. Normal customers never type them.

title: Block every ../
explain: ../ climbs up one folder. It also appears in normal notes about folders.

title: Block ../ that reaches system files
explain: Only blocks climbing up when it heads for system files like /etc/passwd or win.ini.

title: Block ..\ (Windows style)
explain: Windows uses backslashes, so ..\ climbs up folders there.
